title: Build lightweight pibot-style Codec brain
Integrate rendered MGS sounds into frontend
close_reason: src/services/sfx.ts WebAudio player + main.tsx hooks (call/tune/window/cursor/select/cancel/noise); build green

title: Add codec app configuration
description: Provide initial browser-first Codec overlay configuration: Pi RPC/WebSocket URL, default contact/frequency, contact display profiles, reconnect behavior, and UI defaults. Do not configure STT/TTS/LLM providers here; those belong to the Pi runtime/extension side so KITT and Codec share the same voice/session pipeline.

title: Add standalone overlay fallback design
description: Document the optional future mode where Codec can run without a Pi TUI by using a headless Pi SDK/RPC runtime. Keep this out of the first implementation path; TUI-primary plus RPC sidecar is the default.

title: MGS1 music: MDX sequencer rendering (phase 2)
description: MGS1 music = same 4-byte command sequencer as SFX (see tools/render_mgs_sfx.py) on 13 tracks, loaded from SGxxxxxx.MDX (sng_data 0x4000 header: per-song track pointer tables, see mgs_reversing sd_drv.c sng_adrs_set). Plan: reuse Sequencer + SpuVoice from render_mgs_sfx.py, add 13-track song mode + master fades. Alternative for listening copies: joshw.info PSF rip (original driver, music only). XA-streamed tracks (e.g. The Best Is Yet To Come) decode via vgmstream.
close_reason: MDX music rendering in render_mgs_sfx.py --music: 84 disc-1 songs validated, parallel render, loop detection; default in install pipeline

title: Scaffold Codec web app
description: Create the initial Bun, Vite, React, and TypeScript project structure for codec, including standard scripts and a justfile. Keep the first version browser-first so the UI can be developed and tested before any Tauri desktop shell is added.
close_reason: Scaffolded Bun/Vite/React/TypeScript browser-first app with scripts and justfile.

title: Wire live audio levels to codec animations
description: Use audio-level and runtime-state events from the Pi overlay stream to animate Codec signal bars, portrait activity, listening countdown, and speaking indicators. Avoid direct microphone/TTS analyser ownership in Codec unless a later standalone mode explicitly needs it.

title: Define Pi overlay RPC protocol for Codec
description: Specify the RPC methods and event stream Codec expects from the Pi runtime: sessions.list, sessions.active, sessions.switch, contacts.list, contacts.activate, input.submit, generation.interrupt, runtime state events, transcript events, assistant events, active contact/session changes, and audio level events. Treat tmux as process persistence, not the control API.

title: Add PiBot-style Silero Parakeet ASR benchmark backend
close_reason: Added PiBot-style Silero+Parakeet worker backend to ASR benchmark

title: Implement Codec overlay state machine
description: Centralize Codec overlay state transitions for disconnected, connecting, idle, listening, thinking, speaking, and error. Drive state from Pi runtime events rather than local STT/LLM/TTS ownership, while still supporting UI commands such as contact activation, interrupt, mute, and manual text submit.

title: Define codec contact and agent profile model
description: Create the data model for Codec contacts such as Colonel, including id, display name, frequency, portrait asset, Pi contact id, optional Pi session id, voice metadata, and display hints. Contact activation should be declarative: Codec sends contacts.activate and Pi decides whether that means persona switch, session switch, or runtime profile switch.

title: Build first end-to-end Colonel overlay flow
description: Connect the scaffolded Codec UI to a live Pi runtime via RPC/events for a first playable Colonel contact flow. Frequency/contact activation should call Pi RPC, Pi owns the session and voice pipeline, and Codec displays transcript, assistant response, speaking/listening state, interruption, and connection/error states.
close_reason: Added first Colonel overlay flow with Pi RPC hooks, live event handling, demo fallback, transcript, states, interruption, and error display.

title: Self-contained MGS1 SFX renderer: port .se/.efx+SPU playback from decompiled driver
close_reason: render_mgs_sfx.py: full driver-sim SFX renderer, validated against PCSX-Redux SPU trace of codec call (pitches/ADSR/timing match); wired into install pipeline + justfile + docs

title: Add Parakeet Silero STT option for Codec
close_reason: Added Codec parakeet-silero STT backend option using PiBot native worker adapter

title: Integrate Codec with Pi overlay RPC events
description: Build the Codec-side client for the Pi runtime overlay protocol instead of owning STT, TTS, and LLM directly. Consume session state, transcript, assistant text, active contact, and audio-level events from Pi; send overlay commands such as submit text, interrupt, mute, and contact activation.

title: Benchmark ears vs Parakeet ASR variants
close_reason: Added ASR benchmark harness for eaRS and Parakeet variants

title: Rebuild codec mockup as responsive React UI
description: Recreate the existing codec mockup as responsive React components instead of relying on one static Illustrator-exported SVG. Include frame grid, left and right portrait panes, central frequency display, memory/tune strip, signal bars, and lower transcript panel.
close_reason: Rebuilt codec mockup as responsive React components with frame grid, portraits, frequency, memory/tune, signal bars, and transcript panel.

title: Foxline alpha publish readiness
description: Make ../foxline the active source-of-truth repo and prepare a safe v0.0.1-alpha publication. Scope: no copyrighted assets, coherent runtime architecture, fresh install test, runtime smoke test, docs, and explicit known limitations. This supersedes the older codec cleanup/staging work.

title: Adopt foxline as active repo and archive codec
description: Switch development exclusively to ../foxline. Treat the old codec repo as read-only scratch/archive. Initialize foxline as its own git repository if needed, commit the clean tree, and document that future runtime/install/docs work happens in foxline only. Acceptance: git status clean in foxline after initial commit; no active changes required in codec except optional migration note.
close_reason: Done: foxline is confirmed as active git repo, codec is documented as archive/scratch, and validation passes.

title: Prepare optional binary release plan
description: Define how GitHub releases will ship binaries: Bun-compiled foxline runtime, native parakeet.cpp/Silero STT worker, future Rust qwen3_tts_rs worker, and model download on first run. Do not bundle model weights unless licensing/size are explicitly handled. Acceptance: ARCHITECTURE or docs/release.md includes platform matrix and artifact layout.

title: Evaluate parakeet.cpp streaming models for future STT
description: Keep tdt-0.6b-v3-q8_0 as default after benchmark. Track realtime_eou_120m-v1 and nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b as experimental. Evaluate whether Silero is still needed once parakeet.cpp streaming EOU is integrated. Acceptance: benchmark notes captured in docs; no default switch to Nemotron until quality issues like language tags and negation loss are resolved.

title: Run fresh install test from GOG/PC source
description: Validate scripts/install-assets.sh from a clean foxline checkout using a user-provided GOG installer or PC install directory. Test with --skip-setup only if setup has already been validated separately. Verify outputs: assets/generated/mgs_install_manifest.json, assets/generated/mgs_pc/vox-psx-crosswalk.json, assets/generated/mgs_pc/face/manifest.json, agents/*/assets/reference_audio/*_reference.wav, and recursive avatar PNGs. Acceptance: command completes without manual patching and generated outputs are ignored by git.
close_reason: Done: scripts/install-assets.sh completed against local GOG installer with --skip-setup --no-services --no-transcribe. Verified install manifest, PC VOX crosswalk, face/VOX manifests, 7 reference WAVs, 438 avatar PNGs, and ignored generated/runtime outputs.

title: Run runtime smoke test with pi-rpc, parakeet.cpp, and Qwen worker
description: Validate scripts/demo-tmux.sh or equivalent manual launch. Confirm browser connects to server/bridge.ts, pi-rpc brain starts, parakeet.cpp WebSocket STT receives mic audio, Qwen3-TTS worker speaks, interrupt works, and character switching does not crash the bridge. Acceptance: at least two characters can answer with audio; bridge survives character switch; no legacy eaRS/VoxCPM/pibot-lite path is required.

title: Add foxline doctor script
description: Create scripts/doctor.sh to check publish/runtime prerequisites. It should report bun, uv, tmux, ffmpeg, innoextract, 7zz, cmake/git, pi CLI, parakeet worker binary, parakeet model file, Silero model file, Qwen model/cache availability, generated references/avatars/manifests, and ignored generated paths. It should have clear exit codes and no destructive behavior. Acceptance: scripts/doctor.sh passes after install and gives actionable failures on a clean machine.

title: Modularize server bridge runtime
description: Split the monolithic server/bridge.ts into focused modules: brain/pi-rpc, tts/qwen worker lifecycle, characters/manifest/reference resolution, filler/playback, and WebSocket protocol. Keep behavior unchanged. Acceptance: bun run typecheck passes; runtime smoke test still passes; bridge.ts becomes orchestration rather than implementation of all subsystems.

title: Port filler generation to Qwen worker protocol or disable publicly
description: Current filler generation is no longer part of the default all-in-one flow because the old Qwen HTTP service was removed. Either port tools/generate_codec_fillers.py to use the same Qwen worker protocol as server/bridge.ts, or remove/mark --generate-fillers as unsupported in public docs. Acceptance: no documented default command depends on a removed Qwen HTTP server; optional filler flow has a tested implementation if kept.

title: Replace PiBot checkout dependency for parakeet STT worker
description: Foxline currently relies on ~/repos/pibot/native/parakeet-cpp-stt/build/parakeet-cpp-stt-worker. Replace this with a Foxline-owned build path, vendored/native worker, or release binary. Keep parakeet.cpp tdt-0.6b-v3-q8_0 as default for now. Acceptance: setup-deps.sh no longer requires a PiBot source checkout for STT; start-services.sh uses a Foxline-controlled worker path.

title: Implement Hugging Face cache-aware model provisioning
description: Use Hugging Face cache where possible for Qwen and parakeet models, avoiding duplicate downloads. For models/workers requiring explicit file paths, resolve from cache or symlink/copy into a stable Foxline path. Default STT model: mudler/parakeet-cpp-gguf/tdt-0.6b-v3-q8_0.gguf. Qwen default remains Qwen3-TTS only. Acceptance: setup detects already-cached models and does not redownload unnecessarily; docs explain cache behavior.

title: Document alpha limitations and release checklist
description: Update README/ARCHITECTURE with an explicit v0.0.1-alpha status, supported platform assumptions, required user-owned media, no shipped assets, current Python fallback boundaries, default STT/TTS/brain, and known limitations. Include a release checklist covering clean tree, no media scan, typecheck, shell check, install test, runtime smoke test, and attributions.
